message.content:
An orange magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large white letters features ten illustrated human heads in a circular arrangement. Nine heads show distinct facial features, while one wears a dark blue balaclava. White arrows connect the heads in various directions.

At the top, a woman's head with glasses and a pearl necklace faces left. Arrows point from her toward a man with glasses and a thin mustache to her right, and towards three men to her left. Below her, the heads continue in a clockwise path. To the right, another man with glasses faces right; below him, a man faces forward with a slight frown. Following the curve, a figure in a balaclava faces right. At the bottom, a man with glasses and a orange shirt collar faces forward. To the left, a man with a beard and mustache smiles. Above him, another man with a beard and mustache faces right. In the center, a man with a white cap smiles forward, with an arrow pointing from a balding man above him.

Black text at the bottom left reads "BEREBUT PANGGUNG PEMBEBASAN SANDERA". Top text includes "LIPUTAN KHUSUS DAERAH OTONOMI BARU" and "CERITA LUKISAN SERUPA SUDJOJONO." A barcode and price are in the bottom right.
